contentText: Jean-Emile Jammine is joined by Eid Hathaleen, a Palestinian human rights activist, cousin of slain teacher, activist and journalist Awdah Hathaleen and lifelong resident of the Bedouin village of Umm al-Khair in the occupied West Bank. He describes the settler violence devastating his community as systematic, insisting these are not random acts of brutality, but calculated attacks. He says their ultimate goal is the forced displacement and outright expulsion of Palestinians from their land. Innocent civilians and entire families are deliberately targeted, including schoolchildren.
